name: What to Do Right After a Small Kitchen Fire?

step.name: Step 1
step.text: Dealing with a small kitchen fire can be scary, even if it's quickly put out. Knowing what to do next is super important to prevent further issues. First off, make sure everyone is safe and the fire is completely extinguished. Don't re-enter if there's any doubt. Next, ventilate your home by opening windows and doors, but be careful not to create drafts that could spread soot. After that, contact your insurance company right away to report the incident. They'll guide you on the next steps for your claim. Avoid turning on any damaged electrical appliances or systems until they've been inspected. Also, resist the urge to start scrubbing walls or furniture yourself, as improper cleaning can make smoke and soot damage worse and harder to remove. Finally, call in the pros like First To Respond Restoration. We specialize in comprehensive fire damage cleanup, including tackling those stubborn smoke odors and hidden soot. We're here to help you get things back to normal in areas like Encino, North Hollywood, and Studio City.
